node.title: Every 29-record triple-owner type has a synchronized rational pencil or a high-complexity packet
node.closure: the anchor-exchange packet star can be re-based at every sufficiently populated triple-owner pair type
node.statement: Let p be any triple-owner heavy-ruling pair type owning r>=29 first-owned slopes. Re-base the core-recovery construction at p. At most four secondary pair types span all component differences, and each supplies three records, so every order-32 packet retains s=32-3t anchor records with 20<=s<=29. Fix exact supports globally for the r anchor records and fixed secondary records, then use a base packet and one swap for every remaining anchor slope. Either one admissible packet has chi>=2299571, or every packet is rational and all r anchor exception locators lie in one fixed coprime degree-1-through-11 pencil. This synchronizes each populated pair type separately; it does not synchronize different pair types or pay either output.
